method.applicationSource: The executable was extracted from the published release package.
method.launch: The packaged executable was launched on an isolated headless desktop.
method.capture: The first rendered frame was captured through the Chromium DevTools Protocol.

proof: The executable extracted from the published v0.1.0-22 package launched and rendered its first frame.
The captured frame shows the Meadowmark Fields destination, navigation rail, status HUD, terrain, plots, and empty-plot controls.
limitations: This evidence proves packaged launch and first paint only.
It does not prove control interaction, persistence, accessibility, feature integration, other destinations, installer execution, or automated checks.
